issues: The OCR implementation in src/lib/ocr.ts calls FileSystem.getInfoAsync which triggers a deprecated warning in tests (see acceptance output: method getInfoAsync imported from "expo-file-system" is deprecated). This warning causes test failures in the acceptance suite (the warning is printed as an error). The code should use the new filesystem API or suppress the warning to avoid test failures.

The UI components for ReceiptEntryScreen and MileageEntryScreen still use a plain TextInput for the date field (the FormField) and do not replace it with react-native-paper-dates DatePickerModal as required. The DatePicker should replace the typed date input entirely, not just provide an icon button next to a TextInput.

The category dropdown in ReceiptEntryScreen is not implemented – the screen only renders a FormField for Category and never shows a dropdown or the "Add category..." option, violating the task requirements.

The Settings screen does not render the categories management UI; it only has a button that navigates to a non‑existent "Categories" screen (CategoriesScreen.tsx exists but is empty). The categories list, rename, hide, add, delete functionality is missing, so the unit tests for categories will fail.

src/lib/backup.ts now includes categories data in the backup but it stores the raw categories object directly under the key "categories" without using the categories module’s encryption or validation logic. The restoreBackup function writes this raw object back to the store via store.set('categories', data.categories), bypassing the proper shape enforcement and missing hidden/rename handling. This may cause validation failures when restoring backups with categories.
feedback: Fix the FileSystem usage to avoid deprecated API warnings, replace typed date fields with proper date picker components, implement the category dropdown and add‑category dialog in the receipt entry UI, flesh out the Settings categories screen with full management (add, rename, hide, delete) using the categories module, and ensure backup/restore correctly stores and restores categories using the module and validates their shape.
